mapper.select: SELECT * FROM subscribers ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM subscribers WHERE active = #{active} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscribers WHERE active = #{active}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subscribers (email, source, active, subscribed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{source}, COALESCE(#{active}, true), COALESCE(#{subscribedAt}, NOW()), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE subscribers SET email = #{email}, source = #{source}, active = #{active}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE subscribers SET active = #{active}, unsubscribed_at = CASE WHEN #{active} = false THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
